message.content: In the community discussion, the addition of a small water feature was proposed by ArthasMenethil, who suggested that it could "add some soothing sounds and attract wildlife!" Additionally, a seating area was also discussed, with ArthasMenethil recommending a "circle or semi-circle layout" for people to enjoy the view. While a water feature was suggested by ArthasMenethil, there was no mention of adding outdoor games specifically. Therefore, it appears that ArthasMenethil is the one proposing the addition of a small water feature to the community play area.
